kane.summary:
The agent clicked the Default memo visibility control but did not choose Public from its options before reloading. The screenshots also show that this field remained blank before and after reload. Although Always dark had been selected earlier, the final assertion recorded unresolved placeholder values rather than reliable field text, so this run does not independently prove a product persistence defect.
Update the flow to choose the Public option after opening Default memo visibility, wait for the chosen value to appear and its save to complete, then reload. Fix the assertion extraction so it reads the visible selected values instead of placeholders.

verdict.root_cause: The agent clicked the Default memo visibility control but did not choose Public from its options before reloading. The screenshots also show that this field remained blank before and after reload. Although Always dark had been selected earlier, the final assertion recorded unresolved placeholder values rather than reliable field text, so this run does not independently prove a product persistence defect.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent caused the terminal outcome: step 0-14 only opens/clicks the Default memo visibility combobox, and there is no recorded follow-up click selecting Public. Reloading immediately afterward left one of the required settings unset. The test also used unresolved observed-value placeholders at the assertion, which prevents the failed checks from serving as reliable proof that the application lost either saved value.
verdict.bug_title: Default memo visibility option was not selected before reload

retriedAfter.summary:

Fix the checkpoint to resolve and evaluate the actual text or selected value of both preference controls after each reload, then rerun the flow.
